subject: NimbleCart holiday checkout pilot — short-term dedicated slice request
messages:
From: Dana Miller <dana@nimblecart.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: short-term dedicated slice for NimbleCart holiday checkout pilot

Hi Laura,

Quick intro — I'm Dana on the platform team at NimbleCart. We're running a time-boxed checkout latency pilot over the US holiday weekend (Dec 18-31) and would like to request a short-term dedicated GPU slice to ensure consistent tail latency.

Scope summary:
- Target window: 2026-12-18 00:00 PST through 2026-12-31 23:59 PST (14 days)
- Expected steady-state qps: 120 req/s; peak 400 req/s for brief periods
- Model: open-llm gptx-13b (we will pin model version)
- Success criteria: p99 latency < 400ms for generation path; no more than 5% error rate on retries

We understand this may require an autoscale exception or temporary reservation. Attached is our traffic forecast and a one-pager on compliance needs (nimblecart_forecast_dec2026.csv).

Can you advise on feasibility and what Redwood needs from procurement/legal to get a carveout? We have a PO ready if that helps.

Thanks —
Dana Miller
Platform Engineering 
NimbleCart
attachments: nimblecart_forecast_dec2026.csv
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Dana Miller <dana@nimblecart.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: short-term dedicated slice for NimbleCart holiday checkout pilot

Hi Dana — thanks for the clear summary and the forecast.

We can support short-term dedicated capacity for pilots like this, but there are two operational items we need to align on before we commit:
1) Reservation sizing and enforcement: ops will want a concrete slice size and a fallback policy for burst beyond the reserved pool.
2) Autoscale exception end date and post-mortem obligations: to re-enable normal prioritization after the window.

I've looped in Kimberly (capacity ops) and Dev (sales lead) to scope the carveout and procurement steps. Dev — please coordinate PO and billing terms. Kimberly — could you and Marcus validate the pool sizing and whether an autoscale waiver is required?

Laura Bennett
Head of Product Partnerships | Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — developer-first LLM inference
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, dev_patel@redwood.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: short-term dedicated slice for NimbleCart holiday checkout pilot

Laura / Dev —

I ran a first-pass calc with Marcus based on the forecast. Short answer: we can provide a temporary carveout but recommend the following conservative configuration to meet p99 target without risking other customers:

Proposed temporary slice:
- Reservation: 6 GPU slots (A100 equivalent) reserved in the US-west pool
- Autoscale waiver: allow burst to 9 slots for 4 hours/day for peak windows, enforced by time windows and quota guards
- KV cache pre-warm: require NimbleCart to provide warmup prefixes by Dec 15; otherwise we reduce guaranteed p99 SLA

Operational constraints / asks:
- Reservation must be approved by capacity leadership (Marcus) and a signed reservation agreement is needed.
- We will need a single point of contact from NimbleCart for warmup coordinates and a clear rollback signal.
- This will be charged as a short-term reserved commitment; Dev to confirm billing cadence.

I'll prepare a short reservation_proposal.xlsx with the config and runbook. Marcus — can you confirm on pools and any infra caveats?

Kimberly Park
Sr. Director, Capacity Operations
Redwood Inference
attachments: nimblecart_reservation_proposal.xlsx
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 11:22:00 -0800

Forwarding Dana's ask and Kimberly's proposal to ops/infra for final technical sign-off and to product for the rollout plan.

Action items I care about:
- Marcus: confirm pool assignment and whether we need special kernel selection or quantization guard rails for gptx-13b.
- Hannah: product to prepare a minimal canary prompt set to validate quality during warmup and after cutover.
- Dev: lock billing / PO details with NimbleCart procurement and get DocuSign routing started.

Quote previous messages for context.

-- Laura
From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: short-term dedicated slice for NimbleCart holiday checkout pilot

All —

Confirmed: ops can allocate the 6-slot reservation in us-west as proposed, with the following gating conditions met before 2026-12-15:
- Signed reservation agreement (DocuSign link) and PO in hand.
- Warmup prefixes and canary prompt set from NimbleCart validated by our QA runbook.
- Monitoring hooks (tracing, token-level cost reports) enabled for the entire window.

I'll coordinate the pool carveout and set the autoscale waiver for the specified daily peak windows. If NimbleCart needs extended burst beyond the agreed 9-slot ceiling, we'll treat that as an emergency request and require a separate approval.

I attached the signed reservation confirmation when completed (nimblecart_reservation_signed.pdf) and added the internal runbook link in the HubSpot ticket.

Marcus Lin
